title: Tenant resource route canonical User-JWT hardening

phases.objective: Remove the local development JWT fallback from the tenant resource route family and require canonical parsed User-JWT output before tenant resource handlers.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: tenant resource routes mounted by resourceApiRoutes.js
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: An unparsed bearer request is rejected, while a request carrying canonical User-JWT parser output reaches the tenant resource handler without a local verifier or fallback secret.
steps: Load resourceApiRoutes.js and confirm it owns no jsonwebtoken verifier or development fallback secret.
Pass a request with only an Authorization header to the resource route guard and verify a typed 401 user_jwt_required response.
Pass a request with canonical req.auth mode=user_jwt and verify the guard preserves the parsed principal and continues.
Run the shared tenant route regression against workspace, platform plugin, and resource route families.
assertions: resourceApiRoutes.js contains no local verifyJwt helper or jsonwebtoken import.
Resource route guards consume only req.auth produced by createUserJwtMiddleware().
An unparsed bearer cannot become tenant authority.
The regression exposes no secrets and does not require a live database or provider call.
